## What's new

### Continuous surah flow (book mode)
- Read the Quran as one continuous book. Turning pages or scrolling past a surah's end continues into the next surah; going back before its start enters the previous one.
- Dual-page spreads use pages from neighboring surahs instead of showing blank sides.
- Shared printed pages merge surah text, banners, and Bismillah in their printed positions.
- In scroll mode, the page stack flows across surah boundaries in both directions, and the sidebar follows the reading position when audio is not playing.
